methodology.tesseract: All Tesseract figures were measured by running Tesseract.js v7 (eng+fra+equ) on 10 real KaTeX-rendered PNG fixtures. Startup time, per-fixture latency, OCR confidence, and model sizes are wall-clock / disk measurements. Accuracy is computed programmatically as 1 - normalized Levenshtein edit distance between parser output and ground truth.
methodology.pix2tex: pix2tex / LaTeX-OCR was NOT installed or executed. All pix2tex figures are qualitative feasibility estimates based on published architecture, training domain, and ONNX Runtime Web constraints. They are clearly labelled as DESIGN_ESTIMATE throughout.

tesseractMeasured.architecture: 1D LSTM Segmented OCR (eng+fra+equ) + Heuristic AST Parser

pix2texDesignEstimates.dataSource: DESIGN_ESTIMATE — pix2tex was NOT executed on these fixtures
pix2texDesignEstimates.modelSizeNotes: RapidAI/RapidLaTeXOCR publishes encoder.onnx + decoder.onnx + image_resizer.onnx. Total FP32 size is ~100-300 MB per published sources. Int8 quantized size is unknown without performing quantization.
pix2texDesignEstimates.startupNotes: ONNX Runtime Web initialization + parsing large FP32 protobuf tensors into WASM memory. No measured value available.
pix2texDesignEstimates.latencyNotes: Autoregressive decoding requires 1 forward pass per output token. For a typical formula (20-60 tokens) on single-threaded WASM CPU, this would likely require multiple seconds. No measured value available.
pix2texDesignEstimates.memoryNotes: WASM linear memory for ~100-300 MB of model weights plus KV-cache. Exact consumption unknown without measurement.
pix2texDesignEstimates.accuracyNotes: pix2tex is trained exclusively on cropped mathematical formulas from arXiv (im2latex-100k dataset). It has no training data for natural language prose, French text, accented characters, or tabular layouts. Expected to perform well on isolated math formulas (cases 01-07) and fail on prose/tables (cases 08-10). This is a domain assessment, NOT a measured result.
pix2texDesignEstimates.trainingDomain: Cropped mathematical formula images from im2latex-100k (arXiv papers). No natural language, no French, no tables.
pix2texDesignEstimates.expectedStrengths: Isolated mathematical formulas with standard LaTeX notation
pix2texDesignEstimates.expectedWeaknesses: Natural language text, accented characters, tabular layouts, mixed text-and-math documents
pix2texDesignEstimates.browserFeasibilityNotes: Chrome MV3 popup pages are destroyed when the user clicks outside. Autoregressive decoding taking multiple seconds risks popup termination mid-inference. SharedArrayBuffer (needed for multi-threaded ONNX) requires COOP/COEP headers which extension popups cannot set.
